paper.title: Dopamine encodes deep network teaching signals for individual learning trajectories

1H.y: Gaussian-process right psychometric slope minus left psychometric slope
1H.thin_paths: One released Gaussian-process trajectory per mouse
1H.thick_paths: One soft-DTW centroid fitted separately within each released Figure 1J cluster
1H.clustering: TimeSeriesKMeans(n_clusters=1, metric=softdtw, max_iter=20, random_state=0) on [session, right-left slope]

1J.clustering: TimeSeriesKMeans(n_clusters=3, metric=softdtw, max_iter=20, random_state=1) on [right slope, left slope]

preserved: exact released soft-DTW specifications and semantic memberships
separate Figure 1H and Figure 1J coordinate systems
published limits, ticks, reference lines, and naive/expert endpoint colours
changed: The two source panels are composed side by side in one SVG
DejaVu Sans replaces Arial to satisfy the documentation figure standard
Line widths and marker sizes are reduced for the smaller documentation canvas
Panel letters, concise titles, cluster labels, and a standalone endpoint key are added
The released centroid learning-progress gradient is described precisely as increasing brightness rather than hue
behavio_display.claim_boundary: This replays released Gaussian-process fits and clustering; it does not independently refit the Gaussian processes from raw trials or establish three biological types.
